title: zesty baby korean potatoes mixed rice bowl
description: a flavorful and nutritious korean-inspired mixed rice bowl using baby new potatoes, namul-blanch-season, and a hint of gochujang.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.notes: use low-sodium or tamari for gluten-free

instructions: cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
rinse the baby new potatoes and pat dry with paper towels.
heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
add the baby new potatoes to the wok and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 10-12 minutes or until slightly tender.
add the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, and 1 tablespoon of brown rice vinegar to the wok, stirring to combine.
cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until the potatoes are well coated with the sauce.
season with salt and black pepper to taste.
serve the potatoes over a bed of cooked brown rice in a large bowl or individual bowls.
garnish with thinly sliced green onions, toasted sesame seeds, and scallions.
top with toasted chopped nuts, if using.
